title: Egyptian Flaxseed Crunch
description: A crunchy snack inspired by Egyptian cuisine, made with flaxseed, crunchy ingredients, and a hint of grassy freshness.

ingredients.name: egyptian
ingredients.notes: dried herbs, such as thyme or oregano

instructions: Mix the flaxseed, crunchy, egyptian, and grassy ingredients in a bowl.
Cut the toast into bite-sized pieces and place on a baking sheet.
Spread the flaxseed mixture evenly over the toast.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the mixture is lightly toasted.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely.
